title: serapias aculeata
intro: Serapias aculeata, commonly known as the Banded Orchid or Yellow Helleborine, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its unique appearance, with yellow flowers and a distinctive yellow-green leaf, often used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Serapias aculeata include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health, thanks to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
